question: So, here’s what happened: I was doing my usual round of end-of-month accounting (as a freelancer, I track every expense carefully), and I saw a charge from your company that didn’t line up with any of my recent orders. Typically, my purchases are pretty straightforward. I get an invoice or order confirmation, I see it posted to my credit card, and that’s that. But this new charge, which showed up just a few days ago, has me scratching my head. It’s not tied to a specific product purchase that I remember making, nor have I placed any brand-new orders in the last week or so. At first, I wondered if maybe it was some delayed billing for shipping or an accessory that somehow didn’t go through earlier, but I double-checked, and all my other transactions look completely normal.

trace.draft: This charge likely corresponds to a membership fee or subscription service (e.g., coffee bean subscription) that was activated without your explicit awareness. Given your history of inquiring about trial periods, reduced rates, or promotional bonuses, it may be a recurring charge tied to a service you didn’t opt into or fully understand. I recommend reviewing your account settings or contacting customer support to verify the subscription details, confirm if it’s active, and request a trial or cancellation option.
